chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahboub, from Abu Wallad al-Hannat, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'May I be sacrificed for you, they report that the souls of the believers are in the craws of green birds around the Throne.' He said, 'No, the believer is more prestigious to Allah than for Him to place his soul in the craw of a bird, but they are in bodies like their own bodies.'
ai.seo_question: Where do the souls of believers reside after death according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) corrects the popular folk belief that believers' souls reside in the craws of green birds near the Throne, arguing that such a confinement would be beneath the honor Allah bestows upon them. Instead, he affirms the Shia doctrine of 'Barzakh' (the intermediate realm), where souls inhabit bodies resembling their earthly forms, allowing for continued consciousness and interaction. This hadith is pivotal in establishing the physicality of the soul in the grave, distinguishing it from purely ethereal or avian metaphors found in other traditions.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abu Wallad Al Hannat, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! They (people) are reporting that the souls of the Believers are in the craw of green birds around the Throne’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No. The Believers are more prestigious to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> than for Him<sup>azwj</sup> to Make his soul to be in craws of a bird, but they are in bodies like their own bodies’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from abu Walfad al-Hannat who has said the following: “I asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ’

May Allah keep my soul in service for your cause, they narrate that the souls of the believing people are kept in the craw of green birds that live around the Throne.’ The Imam replied, ‘Believing people are very much respectable before Allah. He does not keep them in the craw of birds. In fact, He keeps them in bodies like their bodies.’”
